regime_context: The detector shows a narrowing eligible set (6/17) with only one theme, Tech Hardware & Semis, above its 0.75 trend-gate and durable enough to hold leadership. Diversified Miners rank first on momentum score but are NOT eligible (below trend-gate), so the read is not a clean one-narrative regime; most themes are below gate and the rotation is directional=false. Given gate_helps=true, the honest framing is to favor the one gate-eligible, durable trend while avoiding calls on everything else.
emerging_watch: Watching whether Tech Hardware & Semis can improve breadth above 0.65 while staying eligible and durable — that would confirm a genuine leadership handoff from the ineligible Diversified Miners leader; if instead the durability_bar breaks below 0.75, the challenger thesis retires.

theses.subject: High-Dividend Blue Chips
theses.thesis: The trend-gate leg is the only validated edge, and High-Dividend Blue Chips is the strongest combination of durability_bar (0.83), breadth (1.0), and hurst_tag=trend among ELIGIBLE themes. Momentum rank is only #5, but rank-IC is ~0 so that is irrelevant; what matters is that this theme clears the absolute-trend gate with the widest breadth and a durable, non-crowded positioning. This is a staying-power, drawdown-avoidance lean, not a return forecast.
theses.dissent: High-dividend themes in HK are often rate/China-policy sensitive and can lag a sharp risk-on rally in tech hardware; the detector says nothing about forward return, only drawdown control, so an overweight here may simply mean less downside, not upside.

theses.subject: Tech Hardware & Semis
theses.thesis: This is the only theme that is both eligible AND the rotation challenger to the ineligible leader (Diversified Miners). Durability_bar=0.75 clears the gate, hurst_tag=trend, and it is not crowded.
